name: Hold Onto Mi
source:
Follow Newa C. Count in his adventures in a high school filled with dinosaurs for students, meeting a colorful cast of characters, finding out how to deal with his new environment, and potentially finding love.

Based on the works of Snoot Game and I Wani Hug That Gator.

[From [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bXWvUDH2Xe4&t=59]YouTube[/url]]
